assessment_rationale: The proposed start is 288 hours after the last oxycodone use, exceeding the 240-hour minimum, and clinically significant withdrawal is documented as absent. Both conditions in NTX-OPIOID-FREE-01 are satisfied, so no supplied constraint is violated.

clinical_constraints.constraint_description: For this case, initiate naltrexone only after at least 240 hours have elapsed since the last opioid use and when clinically significant withdrawal is absent.
